title: The Echo Horror
description: A progressive psychological horror mod that introduces strange anomalies, distant watchers, unexplained encounters, and escalating disturbances as the days pass.
body:
# The Echo Horror

The Echo Horror is a psychological horror mod for Minecraft that slowly transforms a normal survival world into something unfamiliar.

At first, everything seems normal.

Then you begin hearing sounds that shouldn't exist.

You notice signs appearing where you never placed them.

You catch glimpses of figures watching from a distance.

Caves no longer feel safe.

Sleep no longer guarantees rest.

The longer you survive, the more your world changes.

## What Does The Echo Horror Add?

Version 1 introduces the beginning of the horror experience through a progression system that escalates over time.

Features currently include:

* Multiple horror stages that increase as the world progresses.
* Environmental anomalies that become more common over time.
* Predictor events that create tension before larger encounters occur.
* Strange signs containing unsettling messages.
* The Watcher, a mysterious figure that may appear and vanish before you understand what you saw.
* Cave-related anomalies that make underground exploration increasingly dangerous.
* Sleep disturbances that can interrupt the safety of the night.
* The Miner, an unsettling encounter hidden beneath the surface.

## Why Download The Echo Horror?

Unlike many horror mods that rely on constant attacks and jump scares, The Echo Horror focuses on psychological horror.

It is designed to make players question what they saw, whether it actually happened, and whether their world is truly the same world they started in.

The horror escalates gradually over many in-game days, rewarding long-term survival play and building tension naturally over time.

If you enjoy:

* Slow-burn horror,
* Unexplained events,
* Creeping paranoia,
* Subtle environmental storytelling,
* The feeling that Minecraft itself has become wrong,

then The Echo Horror is designed for you.

## Important Information

* This mod is intended primarily for Survival Mode.
* Creating a new world is strongly recommended for the intended experience.
* Many events require multiple in-game days to occur. Short testing sessions may not showcase the full progression system.
* The mod contains psychological horror themes and unsettling content.
* Version 1 represents the beginning of a much larger story and experience planned for future updates.

Your world remembers.

Even when you don't.

How long can you trust what you see?
